description: Fields from competitors/findings.jsonl that the contract has no place for, keyed by contract record_id / claim_id. Not read by the team validator or exporter.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0001.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the front and rear styling is elegant and eye-catching.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0002.statement: Owner states there is noticeable wind and road noise, with a humming sound at higher speeds.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0003.statement: Owner states the drivetrain is a main reason for satisfaction with the 530Li.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0004.statement: Owner states the ride comfort is good.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0005.statement: Owner states the rear design is too conservative.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0006.statement: Owner states the 360-degree camera and parking aids are among the things they like most.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0007.statement: Owner states the price has barely dropped while rival brands have cut prices sharply.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0008.statement: Owner (previously drove a Mazda Atenza) states noise insulation is good.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0009.statement: Owner states they dislike the hidden (flush) door handles.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0010.statement: Owner who test-drove the Audi A6L and the new Cadillac CT6 states the A6L felt comfort-oriented and less sporty, and the CT6 less agile than the BMW.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0011.statement: Owner states current discounts plus brand strength and resale value made the 5 Series better value than the Audi A6L and Cadillac CT6.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0012.statement: Owner states the test drive showed strong power.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0013.statement: Owner states the raised rear centre floor tunnel is awkward for elderly or child passengers.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0014.statement: Owner states the lighting is a highlight of the car.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0015.statement: Owner states features were removed, citing a sunroof that cannot open and no electric adjustment of the rear passenger seat.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0016.statement: Owner states the trunk is small even though the car carries no spare tyre.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0017.statement: Owner states the left rear window motor was faulty at delivery.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0018.statement: Owner states the gear selector is easy to misoperate, slipping from S into N.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0019.statement: Owner states fuel consumption exceeds 10 L/100 km in congested city traffic.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0020.statement: Owner who compared the Mercedes E-Class and Audi A6L states the 5 Series still feels easier to drive than both rivals.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0021.statement: Owner states the interior falls noticeably short of the Mercedes E-Class.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0022.statement: Owner states the interior is clearly better than the Audi A6L's.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0023.statement: Owner states initial acceleration from standstill is quicker than the Mercedes E-Class.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0024.statement: Owner states the Mercedes E-Class pulls harder in the mid-range, and the BMW throttle response feels light.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0025.statement: Owner states handling has lost some edge, with noticeable body roll in quick steering, which they attribute to a removed anti-roll bar.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0026.statement: Owner dislikes the rear design and that the Hofmeister kink was dropped.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0027.statement: Owner states the new car has a noticeable interior odour.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0028.statement: Owner states maintenance costs are high.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0029.statement: Owner of a 525Li states fuel use is low (about 7.5 L/100 km).

luis:cn_german_g68-F0030.statement: Owner states the car no longer comes with Pirelli run-flat tyres and sees some cost-cutting.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0031.statement: Owner of a 525Li states the headlights are bright and distinctive.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0032.statement: Owner states tyre noise becomes noticeable above about 120 km/h.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0033.statement: Owner states the interior materials are good and the screen feels high-tech.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0034.statement: Owner of a 525Li states handling, ride comfort and driving feel are what they like most.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0035.statement: Owner states acceleration is good but the driving feel is not as good as the Mercedes E300.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0036.statement: Owner states the exterior looks too youthful and prefers the more businesslike look of the previous 5 Series.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0037.statement: Owner states the interior feels localized and less grand than earlier premium models.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0038.statement: Owner states the dealer (4S store) service was poor and they felt disrespected.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0039.statement: Owner of a 525Li states the ride is smooth and steering needs only small inputs.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0040.statement: Owner states the audio quality is very good.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0041.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:cn_german_g68-F0041.statement: Owner states the driver-assistance systems make the car easy to drive for less experienced drivers.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0042.statement: Owner states real-world fuel consumption is higher than expected.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0043.statement: Owner of a 525Li states a clicking, electrical-sounding noise comes from the brake pedal area when braking in D at low speed in traffic.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0044.statement: Owner states the car lacks keyless entry and the sunroof cannot be opened.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0045.statement: Owner states the suspension is too soft.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0046.statement: Owner of a 525Li (previously a Cadillac XTS) states the 190 hp engine is sufficient.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0047.statement: Owner states the rear is spacious enough to cross legs with the front seat set for the driver.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0048.statement: Owner states there is an abnormal noise when turning the steering wheel at standstill.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0049.statement: Owner states the nose dips noticeably under braking.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0050.statement: Owner of a 525Li states rear legroom is generous and the trunk takes two 28-inch suitcases.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0051.statement: Owner states the chassis feels solid and filters bumps well.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0052.statement: Owner states the front seats are only heated, not ventilated, and the seat covering is synthetic leather.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0053.statement: Owner states the audio system is a basic one and recommends the 530Li for buyers who want ventilated seats or premium audio.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0054.statement: Owner states large dealer discounts put the 525Li below the price of a Mercedes E 260 L.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0055.statement: Owner states they value the dual screens and wireless CarPlay.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0056.statement: Owner of a 525Li states the gearbox shifts smoothly without jerks in stop-and-go traffic.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0057.statement: Owner states voice control works well.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0058.statement: Owner states the wireless charging pad is badly placed and charges slowly.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0059.statement: Owner states the cupholders do not hold drinks securely.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0060.statement: Owner states auto start-stop is annoying and has to be switched off manually every drive.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0061.statement: Owner states the infotainment system is occasionally slow to start up and respond.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0062.statement: Owner states city commuting uses about 12-13 L/100 km and a full tank gives under 600 km.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0063.statement: Owner of a 525Li states the air conditioning does not cool, with vents measuring about 28 C at a 19.5 C setting, and took the car to the dealer.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0064.statement: Owner who considered the Audi A6L and Mercedes E-Class states the BMW interior is more fashionable than both, especially the crystal ambient lighting.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0065.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:cn_german_g68-F0065.statement: Owner states the L2 driver assistance works well.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0066.statement: Owner states the assisted lane change does not complete the move to the next lane.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0067.statement: Owner states the audio system was de-contented and the sunroof cannot be opened.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0068.statement: Owner states there is an abnormal noise when steering at standstill.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0069.statement: Owner wants the voice assistant to be able to control the sunroof.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0070.statement: Owner states they are not used to the gear selector.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0071.statement: Owner states the interior feels livelier than the Audi A6's and the ambient lighting is outstanding.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0072.statement: Owner states the rear doors need a lot of force to close.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0073.statement: Owner states the dealer service was good and they were satisfied after negotiating the price.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0074.statement: Owner states they got a 5 Series for 3 Series money, giving strong value in the class.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0075.statement: Owner states the 2025 model year has fewer speakers than before.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0076.statement: Owner wants the iDrive rotary controller to support handwriting input.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0077.statement: Owner of a 525Li states the 2.0T with 8-speed automatic pulls away briskly and Sport Boost gives strong overtaking.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0078.statement: Owner states a 1.78 m adult sits comfortably in the rear and the trunk is large.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0079.statement: Owner states the car lacks keyless entry and a 360-degree camera.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0080.statement: Owner wants the windows to close automatically when the car is locked.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0081.statement: Owner of a 530Li states power is strong in Sport mode with a good exhaust note.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0082.statement: Owner states the brakes squeal when pulling away and stopping.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0083.statement: Owner states the tail lights are less appealing than the previous generation's.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0084.statement: Owner states some surfaces feel like faux leather and the door trim looks busy with many seams.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0085.statement: Owner states there is very little wind noise on the highway.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0086.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the front crystal ambient lighting is what they like most.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0087.statement: Owner states there is no ambient lighting in the rear, which feels plain.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0088.statement: Owner states the new car has brake noise, which they attribute to break-in.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0089.vfc_level2: BMW ConnectedDrive upgrades/ MINI CONNECTED upgrades
luis:cn_german_g68-F0089.statement: Owner of a 530Li objects that remote climate start costs extra and the data plan is free for only three months.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0090.statement: Owner states the stock Harman Kardon audio sounds muddy, so they added an aftermarket DSP amplifier.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0091.statement: Owner states CarPlay can be customised on the large screen.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0092.statement: Owner states a Mercedes E300 would have cost roughly 60,000 yuan more, which favoured the 5 Series.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0093.statement: Owner states there is some jerkiness at low speed, although throttle and gearbox respond better than their previous car.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0094.statement: Owner of a 530Li states spare parts are very expensive relative to the vehicle price.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0095.statement: Owner states the car shakes slightly side to side when auto start-stop restarts the engine.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0096.statement: Owner who cross-shopped the Audi A6 45 quattro and Mercedes E300 states the interior is not as luxurious as a Mercedes but acceptable.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0097.statement: Owner states adaptive cruise control works well on highways.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0098.statement: Owner states the wireless phone charger is useless.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0099.vfc_level2: BMW ConnectedDrive upgrades/ MINI CONNECTED upgrades
luis:cn_german_g68-F0099.statement: Owner objects that remote climate control costs an extra 2,300 yuan.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0100.statement: Owner states the long wheelbase makes the car spacious.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0101.statement: Owner of a 530Li states fuel use is better than expected.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0102.statement: Owner states the brakes make noise at low speed.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0103.statement: Owner states the seats have no ventilation and no lumbar support.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0104.statement: Owner wants to be able to disable auto start-stop permanently.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0105.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the car has no ventilated seats.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0106.statement: Owner states the audio has 12 speakers versus 16 on the 3 Series, with Bowers and Wilkins reserved for the top trim.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0107.statement: Owner states the price, exterior, interior and dealer service were all satisfying.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0108.statement: Owner who upgraded from a 3 Series states other cars do not drive as well and the BMW makes driving enjoyable.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0109.statement: Owner concedes the BMW interior does not match the luxury of the Mercedes E-Class.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0110.statement: Owner rates the 5 Series as better value than the Mercedes E-Class.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0111.statement: Owner states the rear feels smaller than in the previous generation despite the longer body.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0112.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the car is noisy.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0113.statement: Owner states fuel consumption is high at about 11.2 L/100 km.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0114.statement: Owner states auto start-stop engages too frequently.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0115.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the brakes judder outside Sport mode and squeal when parking.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0116.vfc_level2: BMW ConnectedDrive upgrades/ MINI CONNECTED upgrades
luis:cn_german_g68-F0116.statement: Owner objects that remote start costs extra and the data plan covers only three months, less than on the 3 Series.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0117.statement: Owner states navigation guidance stops when other audio is playing.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0118.statement: Owner states a 1.80 m passenger can cross legs in the rear.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0119.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the interior, ambient lighting and floating curved screen are what they like most.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0120.statement: Owner states the budget Hankook tyres do not fit the price and plans to replace them.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0121.statement: Owner praises the automatic emergency braking.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0122.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the seats are supportive and comfortable.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0123.statement: Owner states wind and tyre noise are noticeable on highways.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0124.statement: Owner of a 530Li states after-sales service is poor, especially at their Chongqing dealer.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0125.statement: Owner states sound insulation is poor.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0126.statement: Owner states city fuel economy is better than an Audi they compare it with (model not named), though highway economy is not as good.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0127.statement: Owner of a 530Li states driving is precise and smooth.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0128.statement: Owner states rear legroom, rear headroom and trunk size are tight and the car's weak point.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0129.statement: Owner of a 530Li states the exterior is streamlined, sporty and elegant.

luis:cn_german_g68-F0130.statement: Owner states the interior feels less luxurious than peers and lacks refinement.
